title: Graphical Merino–Welsh conjecture
statement: Every loopless bridgeless graph satisfies T_G(1,1)≤max(T_G(2,0),T_G(0,2)).

counterexample.description: A loopless bridgeless graph with \(T_G(1,1)>\max\{T_G(2,0),T_G(0,2)\}\). All three quantities are exact Tutte-polynomial evaluations, allowing deletion–contraction or specialized counting certificates; a 2026 paper still treats the graph statement as open.
